title: Right to Erasure: One Month to Answer, Every Copy to Find
meta_description: Under the GDPR, answer an erasure request without undue delay and within one month; the CCPA rules give 45 calendar days. Grounds, exceptions, backups.
secondary_keywords: gdpr right to be forgotten backups

image.takeaway: Under the GDPR, answer an erasure request within one month; under the CCPA rules, within 45 calendar days.
image.alt: Hero card for an article on the right to erasure: under the GDPR, answer an erasure request within one month, and under California’s CCPA rules, within 45 calendar days.

key_numbers.source: Read on 18 November 2026 from the GDPR on EUR-Lex, the ICO’s right to erasure guidance, section 76 of the Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 and S.I. 2026/82 on legislation.gov.uk, California Civil Code 1798.105, 1798.130 and 1798.140, and 11 CCR 7021 and 7022 as published by Cornell LII. The ICO says its guidance is under review after the Data (Use and Access) Act.
